Two levels collide iff a power of lambda is odd/odd rational. The subgroup of resonant exponents has minimal generator k, lambda^k=a/b reduced odd/odd; levels split into k noncolliding residue classes. Primitive zero frequencies are uniquely indexed by j=0 or j>=1 with a not dividing odd u; the multiplicity is 1+max{d:b^d divides u}. Exact inclusion-exclusion among odd u and convergent geometric sums produce density (b-1)^2/[pi b^(m+1)(1-lambda)] and first multiplicity-m frequency pi b^(m-1)/2; factor-counting gives the universal weighted density. Independent rational exact factor collisions and first-occurrence calculations passed.
